scope: Ordinary-v2 smooth body/clothing fit and bounded mixed PixelOE preview. This does not claim individual visual inspection of all192 final exports.

pixelChecks.coarseBodyFineFaceProfile: Coarse128x160logical at3x; fine192x240logical at2x; aligned6px whole-cell selection. Finishing worker supplies deterministic/grid provenance.
pixelChecks.thumbnailLimit: Whole waist-up faces are intrinsically tiny at40x50. Individual iris/pupil structure is not asserted at that size; a UI needing facial detail should use a closer portrait crop or larger display.

limitations: Younger stages reuse age-scaled M/F geometry with skin-surface modulation and infant swaddle coverage. Their anatomy is stylized; this is not an independently generated or anatomically validated infant/child body set.
Manually annotated source eye/chin/mask coordinates are approximate; the final judgment here relies on reviewed joined smooth proofs, not nominal anchor labels.
The complete192-export set still requires its automated integrity/grid checks and final delivery gallery spot review; this report's individual mixed-pixel coverage is eight cases.
decision: Smooth geometry accepted and bounded mixed profile accepted for full192 generation. Preserve the coverage limits above in delivery claims.
priorCorrection: EarlierV1 QA was insufficient because contact sheets and absence of alpha holes did not establish anatomical fit. V2 review uses native-scale neck/collar crops and explicit canonical-body checks.
